description: Source code for the TagMutator class, which manages modifications to Tag items including setting properties, managing parent-child relationships, and references to files and notes.

classes.name: TagMutator
classes.description: A class that extends DecryptedItemMutator to provide functionality for mutating Tag items, including setting properties, managing parent-child relationships, and references to files and notes.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new TagMutator with a given item and mutation type.

methods.name: set title
methods.description: Sets the title of the tag.

methods.name: set expanded
methods.description: Sets the expanded state of the tag.

methods.name: set iconString
methods.description: Sets the icon string of the tag.

methods.name: get preferences
methods.description: Retrieves the preferences for the tag, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: set preferences
methods.description: Sets the preferences for the tag.

methods.name: makeChildOf
methods.description: Makes the current tag a child of the specified parent tag.

methods.name: unsetParent
methods.description: Removes the parent reference from the tag.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a file reference to the tag.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file reference from the tag.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note reference to the tag.

methods.name: removeNote
methods.description: Removes a note reference from the tag.
